description: What the news says about the country of a currency, day by day. Without a currency: the map of covered currencies ranked by the 7-day fall in the tone of the news. With a currency: its latest day — a label (negative … positive) and the direction of the trend (free level, one day behind); Pro keys of EM FX News & Sentiment also get the score (−1 … 1), the index against the country's own 90-day norm, the number of articles, the early signal when the tone falls while the street rate is calm, the global topics (macro, crypto, markets) and the link between the tone and the next 1-, 3- and 7-day moves of the street rate, with confidence.
